comment: The one source of truth for what the server and the assistant panel must agree on:
the states the server projects, the limits it clips by, and the copy it sends. The
server validates against this file, the panel imports it, and
tests/test_panel_contract.py refuses any value that only one side knows about.
What only the panel reads is the frontend's (frontend/src/presentation.json).
A constant that lives in two places drifts; F8b is what that costs.
What the timeline says for a state the product publishes without prose of its own.
It used to travel in the event payload as `The agent is working on the request.` --
an English sentence, in a panel whose every other string is Chinese, saying only
that the thing you just started had started.

lapse_codes_comment: Why a session ended when nothing about it was wrong: its sign-in lapsed while nobody was
using it, the page went quiet, or the host restarted or replaced it. The person's session
comes back as it was the next time they ask, so the panel says nothing about these.
